scope: Read-only audit of reusable code. No new-model entrypoint executed or approved yet.

Replace old8/24/32/48 aggregate constants and per-arm registration loops; count exactly144RAW,7200 generator forward,144D0,zero training.

Old G.snap checks device free-minus-headroom only. Add allocator context headroom and dispatch/current resources. Single-PID VRAM can be NA; never equate reserved with process usage or claim a hard6GiB process bound from allocator cap alone.
Freeze source corner and vertex mapping perC. RAW retains canonical C; POST must retain C_original ordered geometry after source export; do not guess missing mappings.
Final audit checks every proposal_receipt model_forwards==1 and fixed D0 hash; cached_proposal currently checks raw/checkpoint/output hashes but not model_forwards.
Freeze new entrypoints/common/prepare and actual scaling loader, denoiser, source-winding, scorer dependencies before model execution. Old quick code hash list lacks explicit scaling loader file.
Each query bank must match condition/source identities. New DEV cannot use a differentC old query bank. Preserve scales, free-only comparison, RAW/POST separation and NA.

Separate familiar32 and DEV16 outputs; average noises within eachC/parent before cross-parent comparisons. Four newDEV parent IDs excluded from67 is necessary but alone does not certify shape-level novelty.

recovery_contract: Existing validated cells are reused; any unresolved reservation/cell stops without fresh noise or silent model replay. A completed D0 proposal may be reused only with exact raw/model/output provenance; geometry recovery stays explicitly logged.
review_limit: No new entrypoint implementation existed at start of audit. These are review requirements, not findings that the new implementation is wrong.
